notes.title: MASSIVE Launch Discount
notes.content:
Can't thank you guys enough for making this happen.

To celebrate our launch, we are offering a 81% discount on the Billionaire Bonus Pack (BBP). This should help you progress faster in the game.

The BBP includes

- Billionaire Tech Rewards
- Billionaire Engineer Rewards
- Billionaire Music Mogul Rewards
- Billionaire Boost Rewards
- Billionaire Banana Rewards (yep there's a giant banana)
